C0114.title: Multiple Illegal Cases Filed and Investigated: SAMR Reports Disposition of Issues Exposed at the '3·15' Gala
C0114.summary: In March 2026, the State Administration for Market Regulation reported progress on addressing issues exposed at the '3·15' Gala. It launched a campaign to improve online food safety compliance, targeting problems in livestream-sold food and health food, and cracked down on illegal practices such as false marketing and forging or misusing test reports. The actions included investigations into fraud
